description: Use this when someone asks to add a new member to a gym. Returns the member's id, name, gym and language; the phone and email given are saved but never returned. Not for changing an existing member.

gymId.description: Id of the gym, from list_gyms. Leave it out when the user has one gym.

language.description: Language for their messages, as a code such as en, it or pt-BR. Defaults to the gym language.

phone.description: Mobile number, with the country code when known.

requestId.description: A unique id you choose for this member, such as a UUID. Calling again with the same requestId returns the first member instead of adding a second one.

name: create_member
title: Add a gym member
